title: AnnouncementSubscriptionCollection
description: The results of a search for announcement subscriptions. This object contains both announcement subscription summary objects and other information, such as metadata.

AnnouncementSubscriptionSummary.description: A summary representation of an announcement subscription.

compartmentId.description: The OCID of the compartment that contains the announcement subscription.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

displayName.description: A user-friendly name for the announcement subscription. Does not have to be unique, and it's changeable. Avoid entering confidential information.

freeformTags.description:
Simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type or scope. Exists for cross-compatibility only.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

lifecycleDetails.description: A message describing the current lifecycle state in more detail. For example, details might provide required or recommended actions for a resource in a Failed state.

lifecycleState.description: The current lifecycle state of the announcement subscription.

onsTopicId.description: The OCID of the Notifications service topic that is the target for publishing announcements that match the configured announcement subscription.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing system tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

systemTags.description:
Usage of system tag keys. These predefined keys are scoped to namespaces.
Example: `{"orcl-cloud": {"free-tier-retained": "true"}}`

timeCreated.description: The date and time that the announcement subscription was created, expressed in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339) timestamp format.

timeUpdated.description: The date and time that the announcement subscription was updated, expressed in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339) timestamp format.
